lead.head: Deirdre O'Kane works up a new hour in Cork — then takes two nights at Dolan's
lead.standfirst: The work-in-progress show at the CoCo Comedy Club in September has already sold out, and she follows it with back-to-back nights on the Dock Road in Limerick in October. Work-in-progress shows are where the new material gets its bruises — worth catching before it's a finished tour.
